headline: 英國政治獻金規則解析
context: 英國的政治獻金與餽贈規則，最近因為改革黨（Reform UK）黨魁法拉吉（Nigel Farage）收下泰國籍加密貨幣富豪哈伯恩（Christopher Harborne）500萬英鎊的贈與，又被拿出來討論。國會標準專員正在調查此案，各界也呼籲對大額政治獻金設上限。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Mega-donors are coming under scrutiny with growing calls for donations cap beyond those from overseas investors The question of who funds politicians and political parties – and why they want to give money to get people elected – is an extremely heated one. In principle, UK voters can support their chosen politicians through donations or benefits, as long as those candidates and their parties keep within spending limits during an election period, which is designed to stop powerful interests from influencing the result. However, recent years have seen the rise of mega-donors giving vast sums to political parties, leading to calls for a new cap on the amount one individual or company can donate in a year. There has also been pressure for greater transparency around financial interests after the furore over Nigel Farage’s £5m gift from Thailand-based crypto billionaire Christopher Harborne , shortly before the Reform UK leader became an MP. The rules state that gifts only have to be declared if they are political, and Farage has said it was “personal” and freely given with no demands attached. Parliament’s standards commissioner is investigating the case . So, what are the rules on political donations and gifts? Continue reading...
sources.title: What are the rules on political donations and gifts in the UK?

claim_trace.source_title: What are the rules on political donations and gifts in the UK?

thread_text:
英國的政治獻金與餽贈規則，最近又被搬上檯面。起因是改革黨（Reform UK）黨魁法拉吉（Nigel Farage）收下泰國籍加密貨幣富豪哈伯恩（Christopher Harborne）500萬英鎊的贈與，就在他成為國會議員前不久。國會標準專員正在調查此案，各界也呼籲替大額政治獻金設上限。

本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 7 月 11 日發佈的報導。
threads_text:
英國政壇最近吵的，是「政治獻金到底該不該有上限」。導火線是改革黨（Reform UK）黨魁法拉吉（Nigel Farage），他在成為國會議員前不久，收下了泰國籍加密貨幣富豪哈伯恩（Christopher Harborne）500萬英鎊的贈與。法拉吉說這是私人贈與、沒有附加條件，但國會標準專員已經展開調查。這起事件也讓「大額政治獻金該不該設上限」的呼聲又高了一階。

本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 7 月 11 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 英國政壇最近在吵，政治獻金到底該不該有上限。導火線是改革黨黨魁法拉吉，他在當上國會議員前不久，收下了一名泰國籍加密貨幣富豪500萬英鎊的贈與——大概是新台幣兩億元。法拉吉說這是私人贈與，沒有附加條件，但國會標準專員已經在調查這件事了。
